headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants made a statement with an 18-3 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by Robbie Ray and Matt Chapman's dominant performance. The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the Chicago White Sox 8-6, with Randal Grichuk hitting two home runs. The Boston Red Sox took down the New York Yankees 5-3, with Sonny Gray earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Colorado Rockies right-hander Tanner Gordon, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement. The San Diego Padres have also suffered injuries to Jeremiah Estrada and Ramón Laureano, while the Milwaukee Brewers' DL Hall and the St. Louis Cardinals' Ryan Fernandez have been placed on the injured list. The New York Yankees' Aaron Judge and the Kansas City Royals' Jonathan India are also out with injuries.

The Boston Red Sox made a roster move by acquiring left-hander Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-hander Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded right-hander Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and the Pittsburgh Pirates traded right-hander Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs 18-3 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 18-3 victory over the Chicago Cubs, behind a strong outing from Robbie Ray. Matt Chapman led the Giants' offense with a pair of home runs and eight RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with the Tigers taking the win. Framber Valdez led the Tigers to victory, pitching 5.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 6-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the batting charge. Grichuk hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs in just 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Tanner Gordon Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Heads to Boston in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates traded LHP Joe La Sorsa to the Boston Red Sox on June 4, 2026.
